title: Understanding Neutral
description: Learn how players control space, look for openings, and interact with their opponent before either player commits to an attack.

title: Blocking Basics
description: Learn the fundamentals of blocking attacks and recognizing when to defend instead of attacking.

title: Anti-Air Fundamentals
description: Learn how to recognize jumping attacks and respond with an anti-air attack.

title: Understanding Frame Data
description: Learn what startup, active, recovery, hit advantage, and block advantage mean.

title: Pressure and Offense
description: Learn how players maintain offensive pressure after successfully attacking their opponent.

title: Hit Confirming
description: Learn how to recognize when an attack connects before committing to a larger combo or special move.

title: Drive Impact
description: Learn the basic purpose of Drive Impact and how players can use or respond to it.

title: Throw and Throw Tech
description: Learn how throws work and how players can defend against them with throw techs.
